rationale: The agent submitted return requests without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The user specifically requested cross-refunds to the opposite order’s payment method; the agent processed refunds to the original methods instead, without explaining limitations or seeking approval. While tools indicate the agent looked up the user by email and details, explicit authentication is unclear. The agent did act on the user’s apparent orders and the final info matches the tool calls, but the lack of confirmation and failure to handle or escalate the cross-refund request per policy means the request was not completed in line with the policy.
